name: TS391SNL
notes: Built from this oven's measured capability, not from the datasheet chart, which asks for ramps this oven does not have. Peak 235 C against the datasheet's 249 C, which has never been demonstrated here. The cooling tail matches measured door-shut cooling, so it completes unattended; opening the door beats it and is preferable. Time above liquidus is judged against 60-150 s, J-STD-020's window for the Pb-free classification profile. See docs/profiles.md.
reference: Chip Quik TS391SNL datasheet rev 1.2 (Sn96.5/Ag3.0/Cu0.5, mp 217-220 C); curve derived from data/oven-characterisation.json
